title: What's the weirdest AI game you've made or seen?
author: klas-klattermus
selftext:
Since generative AI came about I've always enjoyed making really weird images, to the point that I got kind of burned out at some point.

Now, after having made games I want to make but realizing I still have AI credits I'm thinking about... What kind of games could I make, even if nobody wants me to? 

So I'm asking that of you, what's the weirdest dang game you've made? Or if you aren't really a weird person, what's the weirdest AI game you've seen?

comments.author: TheVoidCookingBeans
comments.body: What a bizarre way for someone to talk. Quirky random much? How about you just make something and not ask a bunch of strangers, but rather show them after the fact to see if it is weird?

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Just thoughts off my head, not structured. I like strangers, I'm happy to see what they make. Images works differently because they create visuals which mess with the brain, but games are visuals but also interactions so weirdness can also come from the unexpected. Consider foddys game about walking, it was weird because no one had done controlling individual limbs in a game before (to my knowledge) so it became novel. Some things cease to be weird once the novelty wears off, but novelty alone does not make weird.

replies.author: TheVoidCookingBeans
replies.body: Right... OK buddy. Maybe you should get out more, you talk in a way that a majority of people will lose you.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Maybe, ADHD wasn't a thing when I grew up. You were just a "bad apple"
